body.query: select campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign_budget.amount_micros, campaign_budget.period, campaign.status, campaign.optimization_score, campaign.advertising_channel_type, campaign.advertising_channel_sub_type, metrics.impressions, metrics.interactions, metrics.interaction_rate, metrics.average_cost, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.conversions, metrics.cost_per_conversion, metrics.conversions_from_interactions_rate, metrics.video_trueview_views, metrics.average_cpm, metrics.ctr from campaign where campaign.id > 0 and segments.date DURING LAST_7_DAYS and campaign.status = 'ENABLED'

select campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign_budget.amount_micros, campaign_budget.period, campaign.status, campaign.optimization_score, campaign.advertising_channel_type, campaign.advertising_channel_sub_type, metrics.impressions, metrics.interactions, metrics.interaction_rate, metrics.average_cost, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.conversions, metrics.cost_per_conversion, metrics.conversions_from_interactions_rate, metrics.video_trueview_views, metrics.average_cpm, metrics.ctr from campaign where campaign.id = 77
